steps.name: test_category_selection_screen
steps.notes: All 14 expected categories present in the accessibility tree (History, Geography, Art & Culture, Science, Nature, Literature, Music, Health, Finance, Technology, Sports, Nutrition, Daily Life, Film & Television) plus a 'Surprise Me!' option (testID category-surprise-me). List rendered in a scrollable view; all items were exposed in the tree without needing to swipe.

steps.name: test_geography_game_initialization
steps.notes: Tapping Geography loaded gameplay: question text visible ('What is the largest country by land area?'), four options labeled 'A. ...' through 'D. ...' (testIDs option-A..option-D), progress indicator 'Question 1 of 10'. Category label 'Geography' also shown on the gameplay screen.

steps.name: test_answer_feedback_and_navigation
steps.notes: Answered all 10 Geography questions correctly by matching on-screen question text to assets/questions.json and selecting the option whose text equals the correct_option text. After every submission the tree showed 'Correct!' plus the matching explanation text, and a 'Next Question' button (testID next-button). Correct-answer highlighting verified visually via screenshot on Q1 (selected correct option rendered with green background/border). On Q10 the advance control changed to 'See Results', which navigated to the results screen.

steps.name: test_perfect_score_results
steps.notes: Results screen showed '10/10 Correct (100%)', 'Time: 150 seconds' (seconds granularity, non-fatal check passed), and all three achievements listed under 'Achievements': Perfect Round, Hot Streak, Triple Win.

steps.name: test_play_again_same_category
steps.notes: 'Play Again' (testID play-again-button) restarted at 'Question 1 of 10' with the category label 'Geography' displayed; first question ('What is the main language spoken in Brazil?') is a Geography question in questions.json.

notes: Core quiz flow fully functional. Fresh state mechanism: app driven via Expo dev-client with Metro tunnel for this run's app; step sequence executed within one session as the plan allows. All fatal and non-fatal verifications passed.
